ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: The column labels of this 4-variable Karnaugh map are ab=00, 01, 11, 10, and the row labels are cd=00, 01, 11, 10. In the diagram, the cd=00 row is 1 at ab=00, 01, and 10; the cd=01 row is X at ab=00; the cd=11 row is X at ab=00; the cd=10 row is 1 at ab=00 and 01, and X at ab=10; the remaining cells are empty, that is, treated as 0. Reasoning: Use don't care only when it is beneficial for enlarging groups. First, in the two rows cd=00 and cd=10 where d=0, form a 4-cell group from the two columns ab=00 and ab=01; these four cells are all 1, so keep the constants a=0 and d=0, obtaining the implicant \overline{a}\overline{d}. Then, in the same two rows where d=0, using the adjacency of the left and right boundaries of the K-map, form a 4-cell wraparound group from the two columns ab=00 and ab=10, in which the X at ab=10, cd=10 is used as don't care; thus keep the constants b=0 and d=0, obtaining the implicant \overline{b}\overline{d}. OR the two implicants together, and the simplest expression is \overline{b}\overline{d}+\overline{a}\overline{d}.

method.method_draft: First describe the K-map entries from the image. Then choose don't-cares only where useful. Make a second 4-cell wrap-around group covering ab=00 and ab=10 across the same d=0 rows, using the x at ab=10, cd=10, yielding \(\overline b\overline d\). OR the two implicants to obtain \(\overline b\overline d + \overline a\overline d\).
